stderr.description:
Buffered stderr capture.

Empty when stderr was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.

stderrCaptureEnd.description: How stderr collection ended, when reported by the execution backend. Missing or null means unknown, not complete. Independent of exitCode and output caps.

stdout.description:
Buffered stdout capture.

Empty when stdout was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.

stdoutCaptureEnd.description: How stdout collection ended, when reported by the execution backend. Missing or null means unknown, not complete. Independent of exitCode and output caps.
